-- Inserir categorias das empresas existentes na nova tabela
INSERT INTO `categorias` (`empresaSlug`, `nome`, `ordem`)
SELECT slug, cat1Nome, 1 FROM `empresas` WHERE cat1Nome IS NOT NULL AND cat1Nome != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT slug, cat2Nome, 2 FROM `empresas` WHERE cat2Nome IS NOT NULL AND cat2Nome != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT slug, cat3Nome, 3 FROM `empresas` WHERE cat3Nome IS NOT NULL AND cat3Nome != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT slug, cat4Nome, 4 FROM `empresas` WHERE cat4Nome IS NOT NULL AND cat4Nome != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT slug, cat5Nome, 5 FROM `empresas` WHERE cat5Nome IS NOT NULL AND cat5Nome != '';
